newsitem.title: RUSSIA: EBRD lends $20 mln to Greek-Russian feed venture.
newsitem.headline: EBRD lends $20 mln to Greek-Russian feed venture.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development is to lend a Greek-Russian joint venture that produces animal feed $20.1 million over 7.5 years to expand its business, the EBRD said on Tuesday.

The loan will enable AO Athina-Volga, based in Volgograd, to complete construction of a sunflower oil processing plant and a slaughterhouse and meat processing plant, as well as to modernise an animal feedmill.
The total cost of the project is $57.5 million, with Athina-Volga providing the balance.
Athina-Volga was set up in 1991 as a joint venture between Greece's Meton-Etep Group and the Volgograd local authority, the EBRD said.
